Module jelena.etfbl.bustraintransport
Package jelena.etfbl.generate

Class TransportDataGenerator

java.lang.Object
jelena.etfbl.generate.TransportDataGenerator
public class TransportDataGenerator extends Object
TransportDataGenerator produces synthetic transport data for a grid of cities, including bus/train stations and random departures between neighboring cities.

The generator creates:

  • TransportDataGenerator.TransportData.countryMap â€“ a grid of city names G_x_y,
  • TransportDataGenerator.TransportData.stations â€“ bus (A_x_y) and train (Z_x_y) stations per city,
  • TransportDataGenerator.TransportData.departures â€“ randomized departures (type, from, to, time, duration, price, transfer time).
Data is saved to a JSON file via saveToJson(TransportData, String).
